premium.basis: The board stated that the $2.00 upfront cash represented a 96% premium to the prior day's closing price.

value_inflection_events.event: FDA advisory committee votes against oritavancin; stock price drops 82%.
FDA issues complete response letter requiring additional Phase III study.
The Medicines Company submits initial acquisition proposal.
MDCO delivers best and final offer of $2.00 cash plus CVRs.

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or reports were identified prior to the official announcement on January 12, 2009.

notes: Targanta was in severe financial distress post-CRL and the board recommended the deal to avoid insolvency, ultimately accepting a $2.00 cash tender offer with up to $4.55 in CVRs as the best available option.
